remarks: Introducing Marrano’s newest townhome design — the Winston A, now available in the highly desirable Midtown Townhomes community. Perfectly situated near shopping, dining, entertainment, and major commuter routes, this brand-new townhome offers a low-maintenance lifestyle with an Association that handles exterior upkeep, giving you more time to enjoy the things you love. Inside, a spacious Family Room seamlessly connects to the Kitchen and Dinette area, creating an inviting open layout ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining. The second floor features two bedrooms, each with its own private bath for added comfort and convenience. A first-floor laundry/mudroom, guest half bath, attached 2-car garage, and a full basement—perfect for storage or future finished space—ensure this home meets a variety of lifestyle needs. Stylish, on-trend features are included throughout, such as a cozy gas fireplace, quartz countertops, white maple cabinetry, luxury vinyl flooring, recessed lighting, tankless water heater, gas furnace, and both gas and electric appliance hook-ups. With modern amenities and thoughtful design, the Winston A delivers exceptional value and easy living in an unbeatable location. Model is located at 20 Cloverleaf #1, model hours are Mon-Wed, Sat & Sun 1:00pm-5:00pm.  ( Taxes are TBD.)
